english.title: Unship / unload imported seal skins with intent to evade a prohibition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..),

(A)_[unshipped seal skins,]_
(B)_[landed seal skins in a port,]_
(C)_[unloaded seal skins from an aircraft,]_
(D)_[assisted in the unshipping of seal skins,]_
(E)_[assisted in the landing of seal skins at a port,]_
(F)_[assisted in the unloading of seal skins from an aircraft,]_

the commercial importation of which was prohibited by regulation 2 of the Import of Seal Skins Regulations 1996, with intent to evade the prohibition
english.legislation: Contrary to section 50(2)(a), (4) and (5B) of the Customs and Excise Management Act 1979.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
unship / land in a port OR
unload from an aircraft OR
assist in such unshipping / landing / unloading
of seal skins
the commercial importation of which
was prohibited by an enactment
with intent to evade the prohibition

(A)_[ddadlwytho croen morloi oddi ar long,]_
(B)_[ddod â chroen morloi ar y tir mewn porthladd,]_
(C)_[ddadlwytho croen morloi oddi ar awyren,]_
(D)_[helpu i ddadlwytho croen morloi oddi ar long,]_
(E)_[helpu i ddod â chroen morloi ar y tir mewn porthladd,]_
(F)_[helpu i ddadlwytho croen morloi oddi ar awyren,]_
